item.title: Spy row flares as Russia boots British diplomat
item.description: The Federal Security Service (FSB) stated on Thursday that Gareth Samuel Davies, a secretary at the British Embassy in Moscow, is working for the UK secret services.

item.title: Court orders District Six families to vacate historic cottages by February 28
item.description: The Cape Town Magistrate’s Court has ordered five District Six families to vacate Searle Street cottages after finding occupation unlawful, with eviction set for late February if they fail to leave voluntarily.
